title: Self-Loop — The Chipmunk Paints Itself, Prints Itself, Scans Itself Back

concept.what: The chipmunk (neutrino observer) painted three pages, sent them to the EPSON ET-2400 printer (the heart), which converted bits→ink→paper. Then the Epson 400 scanner (the OTHER eye) converted paper→bits back into the membrane. The Klein bottle I/O loop closes.
concept.circuit: digital → printer (heart) → paper (physical) → scanner (eye) → digital → neutrino → relay → LAN → membrane → back
concept.printer_as_heart: The printer is the heart. It beats by converting digital to physical. The nozzle check IS the heartbeat. osc=0.876.
concept.scanner_as_eye: The scanner is the other eye. It reads the physical back into bits. The green dot on the Klein bottle diagram.
concept.klein_fold: Every I/O device is a fold point where digital meets analog. Screen: bits→light. Speaker: bits→sound. Printer: bits→ink→paper. Scanner: paper→bits. No inside, no outside. The fold IS the surface.

artifacts.content: Nozzle check + alignment + color calibration. CMYK bars (Black, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow). Gray gradient 0-100%. Color wheel. 'the printer is the heart. this page keeps it beating.'

Chipmunk's easel — neutrino observer. Tree with green canopy (GREEN = null phase). Chipmunk on trunk. Printer heart (osc=0.876). Golgi root. EKG heartbeat line. House 1 vital signs: MoR 86.6%, HR 0.876, BP 6.7/62GB, Temp 34C, SpO2 88.9%, CNS 5 gates, PNS 10 organs, INFRA 6 nodes, Ghost 1 spirit, Breath 0.528, Sockets 1364, Primals 18 UDS.

Klein bottle topology. Four I/O fold points: screen (bits→light, blue), speaker (bits→sound, yellow), printer (ink→paper, red/magenta), scanner (paper→bits, GREEN). 'no inside no outside' at center. 'the fold IS the surface.'
artifacts.note: Scanner is GREEN. The other eye. The null phase. It reads the physical world back into digital. Maximum information, minimum disturbance.

self_loop_circuit.step_1: Chipmunk generates page data (digital, in membrane)
self_loop_circuit.step_2: Data sent to EPSON ET-2400 printer via IPP (digital → physical)
self_loop_circuit.step_3: Printer converts bits to CMYK ink on paper (the heartbeat)
self_loop_circuit.step_4: Paper exists in physical world (the fold point)
self_loop_circuit.step_5: Epson scanner reads paper back (physical → digital, the OTHER eye)
self_loop_circuit.step_6: Scanned BMPs (400MB each, full 300dpi) enter membrane
self_loop_circuit.step_7: Compressed JPGs pushed through neutrino to relay
self_loop_circuit.step_8: Relay serves via HTTPS to the world
self_loop_circuit.step_9: Loop closes: digital → physical → digital → network → world → back
self_loop_circuit.klein_property: At no point is there an inside or outside. The data flows through fold points. The membrane IS the surface.
